name: SH Advance Polls
author: Stunning Hub

sections.description:
Polls and Surveys is a powerful WordPress plugin that allows you to create polls and survey forms with multiple choices and provides analytics after submission. Easily gather feedback, conduct market research, and engage with your audience directly from your WordPress site.

Features

  • User-friendly interface for crafting polls and surveys.
  • Add multiple-choice questions effortlessly.
  • Customize each question to suit your requirements.
  • Set mandatory responses or add additional fields for further insight.
  • Real-time analytics providing valuable insights into participant demographics, response trends, and more.
  • Make informed decisions and drive your content strategy forward.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the sh-advance-polls folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure the plugin settings from the WordPress admin dashboard.
  4. Create polls and surveys from the Polls menu in the WordPress admin dashboard.
sections.faq:
How can I create a new poll or survey?

After activating the plugin, navigate to the Polls and Surveys menu in the WordPress admin dashboard. From there, you can create new polls and surveys easily.

Can I customize the questions in my poll or survey?

Yes, Polls and Surveys allow you to customize each question according to your requirements. You can also set mandatory responses or add additional fields for further insight.
